text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I went to the shopping mall with Zenno Rob Roy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She came to a stop in front of the cosmetics shop.
I wonder what's wrong—did something catch her eye?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no!
I'm sorry, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Such attentiveness, not even missing a gleaming flash
or a decisive strike... A true hero of the ages.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Just kidding.
Hey there, Rob Roy, Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai! H-Hello.
Um, are you out shopping...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. One of the little ponies has a birthday coming up.
I was just in the middle of picking out a present.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you interested in makeup, Rob Roy?
It seemed like you were looking at that blush just now.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat!?!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaah, no...!! That's not it, makeup just doesn't suit someone like me at all!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really? I was a bit curious about it, so I was thinking of giving it a trial run.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't we go together?
Of course, that is, if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-That's...
...U-Um, what should we do?
choice_data_list: If you're curious, why not give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...... Trainer-san,
you're saying so too, aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Then, um... just a little bit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to leave it to Fuji Kiseki for now
and wait until the makeup was done. And then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Amazing...!
Can it really be made this gorgeous...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm glad to see you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm, that's...!
...U-Umm... well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy keeps her back turned,
refusing to look this way.
She seems quite embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's a brand-new challenge for Rob Roy, after all.
Is she still a bit shy about showing it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, it's lovely and wonderful,
but let's keep it a secret between you and me for now, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I muster up the courage someday,
I'll let you see it too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
Could you wait for me until then too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I nodded in agreement to Fuji Kiseki's words.
choice_data_list: Show me someday, when you're ready.
Maybe I should change up my look, too.
Maybe I should try a new look too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I nodded in agreement to Fuji Kiseki's words.
choice_data_list: Show me someday, when you're ready.
Maybe I should change up my look, too.
Maybe I should try a new look too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Zenno Rob Roy that there was no rush
and that anytime would be fine.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! I'm not sure when it will be, but if that's all right with you...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~... Sorry to keep you waiting.
I just went and took off my makeup.
choice_data_list: Wanna go back and buy that blush from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's, no, it's okay...!!
I'll wait until I'm mentally prepared!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's no rush.
Whenever you get interested again, I'll always help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, Zenno Rob Roy wiped off her makeup
and returned with a bright, cheerful expression.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to see that!
Please, produced by Fuji-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure you're fine with me?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! If you combine your sensibility with Fuji-senpai's, Trainer, I'm sure it'll turn out wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you expect that much from me,
I'll gladly do my best to help.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Make him so utterly charming
that the whole academy can't take their eyes off him.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Make her so utterly charming
that the whole academy can't take their eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds like it's going to be amazing!
...Fufu, I can't wait!♪"
